text:
As I approach this glass-walled space, I feel anticipation, as if I am on the threshold of discovery. The environment is modern and tidy, promising a sense of order and innovation.

Upon entering and immersing myself in the R+D exhibit, my mind stirs with excitement and curiosity. Words about responsiveness, research, and human coexistence with technology echo in my thoughts. Surrounded by bright colors and informative screens, I sense wonder about the future, as well as humility, recognizing the persistent human desire to understand, improve, and connect. This place invites me to think deeply about progress and my own small part in the unfolding drama of discovery.
